title: Brand Intervention v0.2: evidence-guided, non-executing reasoning
summary: Brand Intervention binds the current privacy-minimised journey state to time-scoped Brand Journey Population reasoning material and emits bounded objectives, avoidances and obligations. It deliberately distinguishes evidence-construction problems from behavioural/tone signals.
invariants: Confidence-only WEAK_SIGNAL with sound cohort quality stays OBSERVE_ONLY.
A cohort-quality-failed WEAK_SIGNAL routes to REVIEW_REQUIRED and evidence repair, not behavioural guidance.
MATERIAL_INVESTIGATION is review-worthy without becoming population-wide doctrine.
SUPPORTED/STRONG can enable reasoning guidance but never execution.

provenance.claim: Intervention is bounded reasoning guidance, not execution or causal promotion.
Evidence modes and independent cohort-quality handling.
